title: Unify Policy Creation UI across Metric, APM, RUM, NetRoute with single “Set Conditions” experience (Threshold + Baseline + Anomaly + Forecast)
description_summary: Single unified Create Policy flow for Metric/APM/RUM/NetRoute. 'Set Conditions' section exposes four tabs: Threshold | Baseline | Anomaly | Forecast. Baseline support newly added for APM/RUM/NetRoute. Anomaly/Forecast are no longer separate standalone flows. Downstream sections (Alert Message, Notify Team, Take Action, Declare Incident) unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.then: Metric/APM/RUM/NetRoute Create Policy use the SAME layout: header + basic fields + Set Conditions + remaining accordions
Set Conditions has four tabs in order: Threshold Alert | Baseline Alert | Anomaly | Forecast
Anomaly and Forecast are no longer separate standalone policy creation flows
Policy Name mandatory; Create Policy disabled until provided
Counter mandatory for all four tabs
Source Filter controls Source list; Source required when Source Filter not Everywhere/All
Severity Critical/Major/Warning available; operator dropdown (Equals/Greater/Less) works and persists
'Notify if breach within' / 'Abnormality Occurrence' / 'Auto Clear' available and persist per selected tab
APM supports Policy Type switch (Trace Metrics/Trace Analytics) which filters available counters
RUM shows only RUM-eligible counters and source filters
NetRoute shows only NetRoute-eligible counters and source filters
Metric retains existing counters/sources, no regression
Existing Threshold policies remain functional, no behavioral change
Existing Anomaly/Forecast policies continue to function

use_cases.verify: baseline deviation raises alert / window behavior
anomaly policy created without leaving flow
existing Threshold policy renders in unified screen; update values -> save -> persist

gaps: UC5 referenced implicitly but absent (numbering skips 5)
Exact severity operators per tab not enumerated for Baseline/Anomaly/Forecast
Breach simulation / alert-generation is backend-dependent; not pure UI
New unified 'Set Conditions' tab UI + APM Policy Type switch have NO existing automated coverage -> live locator harvest required
